notes: Only es_value_o is assigned. Target correspondence is unresolved: Study 4 and PDF p. 11 locate the relevant results, but the description does not specify an outcome contrast or test. Printed candidates include gender main effect on pride recognition F(1, 205) = 3.47, p < .05 (one-tailed); ethnicity recognition main effect F(2, 205) = 0.13, ns; Gender × Ethnicity recognition interaction F(2, 205) = 0.17, ns; and gender effect on pride intensity among accurate recognizers F(1, 159) = 16.10, p < .05. Recognition binomial tests also report M = 78%, range = 70%–87%, p < .05 against 33% chance without individual test statistics. Further tests concern perceiver effects and false alarms. None is selected as the target from numeric matching, row order, or significance. No effect size conversion performed. The rendered PDF p. 11 confirms column layout and the printed F statistics; evidence quotes use literal ordered fragments of the supplied canonical text.
